basic_profile.bio: I'm a software developer from Austin, Texas, who has a passion for music and gaming. During the day, I work with Dart and other programming languages to build web applications. By night, I'm strumming my acoustic guitar or diving into the Warhammer 40k universe. I'm also a staunch advocate for accessible gaming, having color blindness myself. I spend a lot of time on Reddit during evenings and weekends, sharing insights and engaging in light-hearted banter. Currently single, and enjoying the freedom to pursue my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My expertise in programming languages like Dart comes from both formal education and a lot of self-teaching through online resources and hands-on projects. My musical knowledge is mostly self-taught, with some formal lessons during my teenage years.
